content.label: Been a long time user and evangelist for this app. Whether at work, at home or working on a task - focus@will absolutely works and helps you remain on point. Give it a try and you will not be disappointed!  Life time subscriber!  #topapp

I’ve used this app for about 3 years. I typically use it when grading papers or longer assignments. Sometimes I also use it when reading. During those 3 years the team has continuously worked to improve the functionality of the app. I love that there is a phone and Mac app. The interface continues to improve its display offering some interesting images. One of the best features is a productivity tracker that allows you to see how much work you completed. I find this helpful. 
I do enjoy the music— especially alpha chill, focus spa, ambient, acoustic piano and guitar and classical. Even some of the ambient sounds are nice, but not that conducive for my work. Regardless I find it helpful when I settle in for long periods of work. My only wish is that they would obtain some additions music for the stations or develop some new channels— in particular I would like to see a dub channel or downtempo channel.

I’ve been a long time subscriber and as an adult with ADD it’s imperative for me to stay focused.  F@W has been my go to when my procrastination is high or the environment is full of distractions.  My one criticism would be improving the user interface.  Aside from that, all I can say is Thank you!!!
It works. I keep coming back to it, because it helps me stay in the groove as I work from home. I switch the music at times, just to keep it interesting.
Helps focus on long writing projects. I’m always surprised when a 100 min session is over.

Built in ads are awful.  Interruptions urging you to “try it for free” interrupt your trial about every 20 minutes.  Just about the time that your mind engages, there is another “ad” interruption.  It is extremely annoying, and the reason why I will have to be convinced to give this app another try.

  I realize the company generates revenue by subscription.  However, after 1.5 hours of experimenting, I am ready to abandon it.  If I had one piece of advice for the leadership of this firm, it would be this;  let your users TRY the software for a 90 minute focus block without adds!  Then offer the subscription with “no strings attached.”

I love Focus@Will and paid for a lifetime membership several years ago. I am a professional software developer, and Focus@Will is my "secret weapon" for dealing with my ADD and the "open workspaces" that are so prevalent today. I put on my noise-canceling headphones, fire up the Alpha Chill channel, and I find it much easier to concentrate and tune out distractions.

The app itself has improved greatly over the years, and keeps getting better. ❤️❤️❤️
Love the music. App stops all the time. Completely useless garbage.

I love the app overall. It’s incredibly helpful for when I need to focus and has a variety of soundtracks to suit my mood and productivity goals. The one thing that kills me is the volume of the ding before a new track plays. When I have headphones in, I cringe whenever it plays because it’s so loud it hurts (compared to the volume of the track that begins right after)

Timer function is completely broken. They knew about this before the recent update but chose to do nothing about it. 

Don’t waste you time with this. A subscription to iMusic or Youtube Music will come with all these tracks and so much more .

This app is not usable with voiceover. Controls are not properly labeled and there are user interface elements that are not recognizable by voiceover. This is not an app that a visually impaired user can use unfortunately. Hope they will fix this.

title.label: Cannot switch back to untimed sessions!

content.label:
Made the mistake of trying times sessions, but once you do that, it becomes impossible to switch back to untuned sessions.  Extremely annoying!
Poorly developed UI.  Should hire real developers and establish a QA process before deploying app updates.

I cancelled my subscription a few years ago and recently renewed. I am finding this helps a lot. The time flies and I’m able to have focused work sessions. I’m a manager and frequently need to plow through lots of email or put some time into outlining projects. This is breaking through my dreaded procrastination loop. Try it!

I was just starting to get the feel for this app and then I made the mistake of trying to use a timed session. Once you make this choice you can’t move back to an untimed session. Oh sure, you can try. The help states “If you would like to do an un-timed session, you click the timer button once to return it the to clock icon (no numbers will be displayed)” but that just doesn’t work. Tapping the timer button once just let’s you change the duration of the timer. Very frustrating user experience.

Given the price of this app, and having just found a fairly significant bug, why would I even consider moving beyond  a trial two week subscription??

Love the app but my session stops if I pull my AirPod out of my ear (one or both).

I think AirPods/iOS sends a “pause/resume” signal to the app. Maybe this can be updated to continue a session if only paused for a couple of seconds.

I’ve been using focus@will for a few years now and find it indispensable when I need to focus. I’m easily distracted and find it hard to focus unless I’m blocking out the world with noise canceling head set and focus@will. I used to listen to a “Mozart makes you smarter” CD and other focus downloads in nursing school and at work when I needed to focus, but found some of the scores to be distracting. Once I got focus@will honestly I never looked back, had a few streaming issues a while back but the program and app have been working flawlessly the last year.... Worth every penny!!!

Purchased the monthly plan and was never able to access the app. Was always stuck at step 2 of 3 in the registration process. Didn’t matter what I tried, always reverted back to step 2. Finally grew weary of trying and cancelled the subscription
The service is great and helps me focus but after updating the app no longer works. It plays for about 5 seconds then just stops. Also horrible unresponsive UI. The old one at least worked.

Very Misleading! After you download, you have to register and pick a payment plan, with free trial after you give your credit information. Based on reviews maybe it helps, but it should state the prices or payment plan only.

Full of bugs
Difficult to stay logged in
Randomly stops playing
Launched prematurely
Waste of time and money

See others reviews with the app frustrations. 

Needs for improvement:
1 Resume playing music after an event in the phone (a call or alarm)
2 Allow offline music playing. I have tons of storage room on my phone and don’t want to use data to use the app. 

The music is great, but the app creates interruptions. Major music apps provide a better listening user experience albeit at a cost of musical content not specific for focus sessions.

I have been using F@W for over a year now and I use it all the time on all my devices.

For example:  I use it to limit the amount of time I spend checking and responding to email.  I use it when I am working on a bigger project so I remain focused on ONE THING the entire time I am in that time.  

It allows me to let go of worrying about going over my time in something because I know it will DING when my time is up on certain task or project.

I’ve conditioned myself now to set the timer, and once the initial bell DINGS, I just get into the zone.  

It’s improved my productivity and mental focus in a way that I’ve always wanted and when I use it, I get 3X to 4X the work done I usually do.

It’s worth every penny.  And I coach clients on productivity and focus so this is a tool I always recommend.

Phil

I have no reason to give on why this is absolutely necessary in my life. I’ve tried everything from Headspace to Welzen to all kinds of productivity music tracks...nothing compares to this...at least for me. This is one of the best purchases I’ve made and I don’t really leave reviews for apps. But this one is different. Give it a try. Can’t lose just cancel if it’s not your cup of tea.

title.label: Neuroscience experts need to hire a user interface expert

content.label:
I believe the neuroscience part of this works. I put on the music and I stay focused. Very good. Sold! I’m a lifetime subscriber. 

But the user interface needs work. It slows me down. Please invest in a user interface expert. A few examples:
- The tour won’t seem to go away permanently. Why?
- Alarms interrupt the tune. If I’m using my session as a timer, restarting interrupts the flow since I now have to set a different alarm to get to my meeting on time. 
- Please let me pause without changing the tune. I promise not to abuse it. 
- I never want to be asked about productivity. I just want it to let me go again. If I don’t like the tune, I will skip it. 
- Picking a channel is confusing. On the channel picker page (not sure the official name), aren't Labs channels? Aren't Favorites channels?I suggest renaming the Channels tab to something like Regular (or Proven or Official or Popular or Standard or Normal or Live). 
- Picking a channel takes too long to get back to music. Need to be able to quickly get back to Player from the channel picker screen. Or, just add a Play arrow to the channel picker screen. 
- On the channel picker page, please put the Favorites tab first. 
- Why can't I change the energy level from the player screen?
- Why is there still an Oct Beta Test in April? Where is the beta for Nov? Dec? Jan? Feb? Mar? 

#JustSharing

I’m starting to wonder if this is a real app. I created an acct and selected a subscription but it keeps showing an error. When I try to reselect a subscription, it says I’m already subscribed. When I login, it says my subscription is not completed and I’m back to the subscription selection screen. I verified my email. I deleted and redownloaded. I made a new acct. I got an email saying I must have gotten distracted and not finished completing my subscription....?!?! WELL NOT FOR LACK PF TRYING. But I gave it a shot and clicked the link and it wanted me to select ANOTHER subscription from a different list with lower prices only instead of subscribing through my Apple ID, this one requires a credit card. WTH?! At this rate, I can only hope it isn’t charging me every time it sends me on another subscription selection Wild goose chase for the ever elusive focus that I’ve yet to find. Thanks for nothing, I guess. Super bummed.
Looks way better
I couldn’t get this app to work on my phone with latest OS. I have an iPhone 6s. I’ll try again when I buy a newer phone later this year, but this is extremely disappointing.

I have been a paid subscriber now since 2014. Very pleased with how it helps me focus even when I've had a long stressed day but still have lots of paperwork to get through.
While a nice Pandora channel may be pleasant while I work, I find I still get things done faster with the focus at will music.
This app says that it is free, but you can’t even try it without signing up for their service.  No thanks.

title.label: Does it work?  Who knows, can’t open it

content.label: I’ve tried downloading it three times across two different devices and each time I just get a white screen of death.  I would think about buying it if it worked, but I can’t even find that out.  Oh well!

An indispensable tool for keeping me alert and focused. My work includes a great deal of copyediting and proofreading, and I’m always more focused and accurate – and I miss fewer mistakes – when I use Focus@Will. I also use it for writing or regular editing, to keep me focused and on track. This is the case whether there are other people around me working, or I’m in my quiet home office.

title.label: Useful, but poor value for money

content.label:
If F@W cost $7.99 or less, I’d happily give five stars to the app as-is. It does help me focus!
However, it’s just not robust enough to justify its subscription price. 

At $12.99, the price is extravagant, one of the most expensive subscription apps I have ever seen. 
It costs more than a Spotify subscription! Except unlike Spotify, this is a single-function app with very basic features. At that price, I have to consider how much value I get out F@W versus “focus” playlists on Spotify, YouTube mixes, and free or low-priced study music apps.

At the current price, it needs improvement in AT LEAST the following features:

1. OFFLINE MODE - 

$12.99 a month and there’s not even an offline mode? So I have to pay for data on top that? I’m in a coffee shop with terrible WiFi, and F@W is almost unusable. This would be acceptable at a very low subscription price, but ridiculously annoying as is. For $12.99. I shouldn’t be restricted in using the app!

2. MORE VARIETY - 
There aren’t that many stations to choose from, and not all of them will work for you, so you end up using only a small subset. Mode stations would at least make it feel like you are getting some value for your money. 

3. MORE & BETTER RECOMMENDATIONS -
The marketing makes F@W’s service seem way more personalized than it actually is.
The channel recommender quiz is a nice idea in theory, but it is TOTALLY USELESS to me. It recommends a station for the “type of person” you are, and of course your inherent attributes don’t change. If the recommendation doesn’t work for you (mine didn’t at all), too bad, I guess.
The marketing references music tailored for “creative thinkers”, “logical thinkers”, “entrepreneurs”, and “students”. Based on that, I expected a much more robust recommendation system. People wear different “hats” depending on the task they are doing, and I expected to receive recommendations tailored to that.
I expected F@W to tailor recommendations for creative tasks (writing, design), logical tasks (coding), reading, etc. 

This app is quite basic in its currently form and there’s really no way to justify charging $12.99.

Yes, it is useful and improve focus. I’m loving the functionality that this app provides for my life, but I can’t justify keeping my subscription when I can accomplish something similar for free.

Pros: Very pleased with this app. The initial setup was helpful in matching my style with the best type of music.
Cons: not enough variety per channel. Tracks repeat after a couple of 1hr sessions. This makes it a little overpriced imho

title.label: Very helpful! Especially for those with Adult ADHD!

content.label: I am use this app to help me concentrate and focus on the tasks I need to get done everyday. It’s especially helpful because I have REALLY bad Adult ADHD (the inattentive type). It has several “channels” to pick from and you can also choose what tempo (low, medium and high) of each channel you’d like to listen to, depending on what time of day it is or how well you’re focusing. It then asks you each time you change the channel or change your task, how productive had you been and it keeps a record so you can see when and what you were listening to during your most documented focused time periods...For me, it’s worth paying for the subscription!

Great for getting “in the zone” ...specifically for tasks that do not require interaction with others.
Alpha Chill has always been my favorite. 
There is “ding” at the start of each session that tells your brain: “START!” Controls for length of sessions and productivity tracker over time helps to truly quantify productivity. 
I love it!

I’ve been using Focus at Will for over a year now. It Can take a little trial and error in the very beginning. Test the channels and see what works best for you. Once you nail your top productivity channel, it’s incredibly effective. Only took about 5 sessions to find my best channel and I’m at least 2X - 3X more productive when I have this in the background. Amazing.
When I listen, I laser focus and get tasks done much more quickly and with less anxiety!

title.label: App is fine, support is awful

content.label: I actually have two accounts with them, one of which I do not need, so I tried to close one and they are still billing me.  I asked for a refund within a few hours of being charged (they claim you have 30 days) and now it’s nearly two weeks later and they haven’t even acknowledged my support ticket.  I like the app & music but if you ever need help— especially with billing, you may as well kiss your money goodbye.  I’d be hesitant to try this service if I were you because, at least in my case, cancellation and refund within 30 days is a lie.

I was so impressed with Focus at Will and how it truly helped me to write my master’s thesis and focus on my studies that when it was offered I bout the lifetime membership. 

This app is the most impressive app I have for both its complexity and it’s simplicity. It’s easy to use and it works. The complex science behind it is fascinating. I love the service. Hands down, my favorite app.

Seriously, they should be able to come up with a better app than this. Looks and feels like they got their high school nephew to design and create it. 

I switched my channel to “Cinematic” and High tempo and I got the slowest classical piano music there is. I went through several songs with no luck.

I get just as much done without using focus@will.  I take the in app quiz to help determine the best genre for me once in a while (as people change with time), and has given three different results. Each one I try makes no difference to my productivity. I even try random genres in an attempt to find the one that works, but nothing yet. Perhaps this science isn’t for everyone.  Also, songs eventually repeat themselves, so the more you use the more repetition you will here, which to me gets a bit boring (and to my music playlist I go).

title.label: Useless/creepy you making me enter my password every time I use this sound generating app?? pain

content.label: The app sounds are great. The need to link to internet and include password seems either needless or creepy— and certainly reduces use of this app

title.label: At a crossroads between excellent and frustrating

content.label: This app’s primary purpose and function is excellent. The channels are very well developed, my favorite is the classics music that I use every time that I study. However the app crashes more often than not. If I receive a phone call it will end my session, frankly and any superfluous activity will make the app crash. I have unsuccessful tried to play it on my Sonos wireless speaker in which it will constantly crash the app every time I begin to play a channel. Would love these bugs to get fixed and enhance my studying that much more thank you!

I use this app everytime when I work on my computer and when I workout. Emails and long reports are so much easier. The fast beat drum zone sounds really keep me pumped up while lifting weights. It's worth the price and one of two apps I actually pay for.

title.label: Great service but app needs work

content.label:
Good: I thoroughly enjoy the service. Music really does help from distractions. 

Must be improved:  I need to press the play button twice in a row for the music to start. It’s probably a bug that needs to be fixed. The app crashes every now and again which means it still needs another update. 

Needs improvement: It’s 2018. The app should be a lot better than it actually is especially for the price. For example, why do I need to stream the music. Why can’t I download a set playlist so I don’t have to rely on WiFi/LTE when I am on the go. The app also drains the battery more than Apple Music or even Spotify. The UIUX of the app also needs upgrading. 

Summary: Please, developers of Focus@will, upgrade the app to match the great product.

I have been using focus@will for over a week and notice a remarkable difference in my attention at work. I am getting much more done and taking fewer social network breaks. It is the most helpful productivity app I have ever used!

title.label: A solid, trusted app for dedicated focus

content.label:
The company’s support is great. Very receptive to product improvements. The software continues to improve. It’s my “go to” app for focused work. The variety in the music/sounds keep it fresh. 

Keep up the great work!

I’d love to try using the app but I cannot even do the free trial since I cannot even complete the subscription process. Wasted 15+ trying to wait for the app subscription page to come up. Guess I’ll stick to Spotify for now 😭

I have only been using the app intermittently for a short time but is has definitely been helpful.  I have only been using the acoustical plus category and it is great for background with my earbuds when working on reports on the computer.
Absolutely worth purchasing.

Focus@will helps me focus while I’m studying. It might take a few tries to find the right channel/mood to fit your workflow, but it’s worth it to keep trying to find something you like. I think the productivity tracker is a great idea but it could be improved. Instead of only adding a percentage to rate your productivity, it would be helpful to have the option to add a note next to your session. That way you could record what you were working on, how much you got done, and/or any distractions that got in your way. It’d be a lot more useful to look back on later than just the percentages. Thanks for the great study tool!
